files.role: Sprint 03 entry management endpoints: GET /api/food/entries, GET /api/food/entries/{id}, PUT /api/food/entries/{id}, DELETE /api/food/entries/{id}, POST /api/food/entries/{id}/copy. Contains ENTRIES_OVERVIEW_SCHEMA constant and private helpers _serialise_entry_detail() and _validate_entry_edit_request(). Does NOT import from food.py — edit and intake are separate flows (Option A).

public_objects.name: ENTRIES_OVERVIEW_SCHEMA
public_objects.note: Column order: id (string, sortable=False, detail_visible=False), logged_at (date, sortable=True), meal_type (string, sortable=True, filterable=True), dish_name (string, sortable=True), kcal (number, format='kcal', sortable=True). Row_actions declared in DatasetMeta, not schema.

methods.name: list_entries
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/entries — queries foodtracker.food_logs ORDER BY logged_at DESC, wraps all rows in a Dataset with ENTRIES_OVERVIEW_SCHEMA and DatasetMeta(object_type='food_entry', label='Meal Entries', total=N, page=1, page_size=N, row_actions=['delete','copy','detail']). Returns HTTP 200. Returns ApiError HTTP 500 via install_exception_handlers on unexpected errors.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/entries/{id} — queries foodtracker.food_logs WHERE id = %s. Returns ApiError HTTP 404 (NOT_FOUND) if no row found. Returns the EntryDetail dict (see architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryDetail) as JSON HTTP 200, serialised by _serialise_entry_detail.

methods.name: update_entry
methods.purpose: PUT /api/food/entries/{id} — parses JSON body as EntryEditRequest (see architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryEditRequest). Calls _validate_entry_edit_request(body) (HTTP 422 on failure). Checks id existence (HTTP 404 if not found). Executes UPDATE foodtracker.food_logs SET logged_at=%s, meal_type=%s, dish_name=%s, <all nutrition fields>, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=%s RETURNING *. Wraps updated row in single-row Dataset using ENTRIES_OVERVIEW_SCHEMA. Returns HTTP 200. Returns ApiError HTTP 400 on DB_CONSTRAINT. Does NOT call validate_and_normalise — Option A.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.purpose: DELETE /api/food/entries/{id} — executes DELETE FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE id = %s, checks cursor.rowcount; if rowcount == 0 the row did not exist, rollback and return ApiError HTTP 404. Otherwise commit. Returns HTTP 204 No Content (no body). Single-statement approach — no prior SELECT.

methods.name: copy_entry
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/entries/{id}/copy — selects source row by id (HTTP 404 if not found), assigns new_id = str(uuid.uuid4()), sets logged_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'), inserts new row copying all meal content columns (meal_type, dish_name, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, good_fat_g, meat_g, red_meat_g, sodium_mg, confidence, notes) from the source row, RETURNING *. Returns the newly inserted row serialised as an entry_detail dict (HTTP 201).

methods.name: _serialise_entry_detail
methods.purpose: Converts a psycopg2 RealDictRow (from SELECT *) into an EntryDetail dict (see architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryDetail): id as str, logged_at/created_at/updated_at as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' strings (handle datetime objects from psycopg2), kcal as int, confidence as int, all other numerics as float, notes as str or None.

methods.name: _validate_entry_edit_request
methods.purpose: Parses and validates the PUT /api/food/entries/{id} request body against the EntryEditRequest contract (see architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryEditRequest). Returns (validated_dict, None) on success or (None, error_dict) on failure. Checks: required fields present, numeric fields non-negative, meal_type is a valid enum value, logged_at is a parseable datetime string, kcal and confidence are integers, dish_name is a non-empty string. Does not call or reference validate_and_normalise.

files.role: Sprint 03 entries overview screen. Fetches GET /api/food/entries on mount. Renders a list of meal entry rows with delete, copy, and open-detail row actions. Handles empty state and error state.

methods.name: EntriesPage
methods.purpose: Top-level entries overview component. State: entries (Row[] | null), isLoading (boolean), error (ApiError | null), deleteConfirmId (string | null — id of the entry pending delete confirmation). Fetches GET /api/food/entries on mount. Renders: Skeleton while loading, ErrorCard on error, empty state message when entries is an empty array, entry list when entries is non-empty. Each entry row shows: logged_at, meal_type, dish_name, kcal, and three action triggers (delete, copy, open detail). Delete trigger sets deleteConfirmId to the entry's id, showing a confirmation dialog. Confirming dialog issues DELETE /api/food/entries/{id}; on success removes the entry from the displayed list and clears deleteConfirmId. Copy trigger issues POST /api/food/entries/{id}/copy; on success navigates to /food/entries/{copiedId} using React Router navigate. Open detail trigger navigates to /food/entries/{id}.

methods.name: DeleteConfirmDialog
methods.purpose: Material 3 dialog presented when the user triggers delete. Shows a confirmation message. Confirm button triggers onConfirm; Cancel/dismiss triggers onCancel.

files.role: Sprint 03 entry detail/edit screen. Loads one existing meal entry by id from the route param. Renders an editable form for all supported meal fields except system-managed metadata. Saves via PUT /api/food/entries/{id}.

methods.name: EntryDetailPage
methods.purpose: Entry detail and edit component. Reads the entry id from the React Router useParams() hook. State: entry (EntryDetail | null), formState (editable field values), isLoading (boolean), isSaving (boolean), loadError (ApiError | null), saveError (ApiError | null), saveSuccess (boolean). Fetches GET /api/food/entries/{id} on mount. Populates formState from the loaded entry. Renders: Skeleton while loading, ErrorCard on loadError, edit form when entry is loaded. Edit form fields per EntryEditRequest contract: logged_at (datetime input), meal_type (select: breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack/other), dish_name (user-editable text field — editable in this simplified flow), nutrition fields (kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, good_fat_g, meat_g, red_meat_g, sodium_mg), confidence (integer select 1-5), notes (optional textarea). Non-editable display: id, created_at, updated_at (shown as read-only context). Save button: disabled while isSaving, issues PUT /api/food/entries/{id} with EntryEditRequest JSON body constructed by _buildPutBody(formState) — no items field, no timestamp field. On save success, updates displayed values from the response Dataset row. On save error, displays saveError ApiError message. Back link navigates to /food/entries.

methods.name: _buildPutBody
methods.purpose: Constructs the JSON body string for the PUT /api/food/entries/{id} request from the current form state. Conforms to EntryEditRequest contract (see architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryEditRequest): {logged_at, meal_type, dish_name, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, good_fat_g, meat_g, red_meat_g, sodium_mg, confidence, notes?}. No items field. No timestamp field. dish_name is taken directly from formState and is user-editable. This is the simplified edit contract (Option A).

private_objects.name: EntryDetail
private_objects.purpose: TypeScript type for the EntryDetail response from GET /api/food/entries/{id} and POST /api/food/entries/{id}/copy. Conforms to architecture.json contracts.named_contracts.EntryDetail. Fields: id (string), logged_at (string), meal_type (string), dish_name (string), kcal (number), protein_g (number), carbs_g (number), fat_g (number), fiber_g (number), good_fat_g (number), meat_g (number), red_meat_g (number), sodium_mg (number), confidence (number), notes (string | null), created_at (string), updated_at (string).

private_objects.name: EntryFormState
private_objects.purpose: TypeScript type for the local form editing state. Contains all user-editable fields per EntryEditRequest contract: logged_at (string), meal_type (string), dish_name (string — user-editable in the edit flow, sent directly in PUT body), kcal (number), protein_g (number), carbs_g (number), fat_g (number), fiber_g (number), good_fat_g (number), meat_g (number), red_meat_g (number), sodium_mg (number), confidence (number), notes (string).
